archive.name: refactor-baseline.tgz

matchingRule: Exact {className,name} multiset matching; consume one current occurrence per baseline occurrence and require each matched occurrence to pass. No testcase identity or parameter display-name normalization was needed. Report remaining current occurrences as additions.

oldTestSources.changeBoundary: Two existing migration fixtures retain historical assertions while advancing the final schema to v4; DeterministicProjection implements the added read-only preparation contract. Other baseline Java test sources are unchanged. This hash comparison does not replace independent semantic review.

golden.baselineNote: The frozen refactor archive does not contain golden.json; its original tracked Git blob is the baseline. Current and isolated build copies also match.

reportAggregateAlgorithm: SHA-256 over files sorted by repository-relative path (ascending code-point order); append UTF-8 path + NUL byte + lowercase file SHA-256 hex + LF byte for each file.

previous0007Verification.matchingRule: Reconstruct all 564 prior cases from the frozen prior retention artifact's preservedCases plus additionalCases; exact className/name multiset match against current completed Surefire cases. No normalization or display-name mapping was required.
